# Parse all song lines into title and artist, then search for each on Spotify
import re

song_ids = []
for line in song_lines:
    # Split on " by " to get title and artist
    parts = line.split(' by ')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        print(f"Could not parse: {line}")
        continue
    title = parts[0].strip()
    artist = parts[1].strip()
    print(f"Searching: {title} by {artist}")
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=line, access_token=spotify_token)
    # Find exact match: title matches and artist matches
    found = None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if any artist matches
            for art in song['artists']:
                if art['name'].lower() == artist.lower():
                    found = song
                    break
            if found:
                break
    if found:
        song_ids.append(found['song_id'])
        print(f"Found song_id: {found['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"Not found: {line}")

print(f"Total songs found: {len(song_ids)}")
print(song_ids)
